name: AI podcast
description: The built-in set, made for a podcast about AI: subject and mode lanes, heat and hype, and moments like disagreements, hot takes, predictions, and clips.
prefix: Judge only segment; previous_segment is context only.

categories.name: Subject
categories.instructions: What is the current segment mainly about?

options.name: AI models
options.description: New AI models, labs, benchmarks, research papers or capabilities

options.name: AI tools
options.description: AI apps, agents, coding assistants or developer tools, and how people build with or use them

options.name: AI industry
options.description: AI companies, funding, jobs, regulation, safety, ethics or AI's impact on society

options.name: Tech
options.description: Technology not centred on AI, such as hardware, platforms, crypto, gadgets or startups

options.name: Marketing
options.description: Marketing, audiences, content, social media, brands, sales or growth

options.name: Personal life
options.description: The hosts' own lives, such as travel, family, health, food, sport or where they live

options.name: Other topics
options.description: Anything else, such as culture, science, politics, philosophy or random tangents

options.name: The show
options.description: The podcast itself, such as intros, outros, sponsors, listener comments or housekeeping

index.name: Off-topic
index.description: time spent on personal life and other topics

categories.name: Mode
categories.instructions: What are the speakers mainly doing in the current segment?

options.name: News
options.description: Reporting what happened, such as an announcement, release or event

options.name: Analysis
options.description: Interpreting, giving opinions, or discussing what something means or why it matters

options.name: Personal story
options.description: Recounting their own experience, project or anecdote

options.name: Explainer
options.description: Explaining how something works or defining a concept

options.name: Banter
options.description: Joking, teasing or casual chat with little information

options.name: Transition
options.description: Introducing, wrapping up or moving between topics

scores.name: Heat
scores.instructions: How heated is the exchange in the current segment?

scores.name: Hype
scores.instructions: How do the speakers in the current segment feel about the subject they are discussing?

markers.name: Disagreement
markers.instructions: In the current segment, a speaker disputes or pushes back on another speaker's view.

markers.name: Hot take
markers.instructions: A speaker in the current segment states a bold, surprising or contrarian opinion.

markers.name: Prediction
markers.instructions: A speaker in the current segment predicts what will happen in the future.

markers.name: Recommendation
markers.instructions: A speaker in the current segment recommends a specific tool, product, resource or practice.

markers.name: Clip-worthy
markers.instructions: The segment contains a moment worth clipping for social media: a strong quote, a funny exchange, a surprising claim, or a memorable story.

criteria.true: A moment in the segment would stand on its own as a short clip: a quotable opinion, a joke that lands, a surprising fact or claim, or a story with a payoff.
criteria.false: The segment is routine discussion, logistics, or filler, or its best moment only makes sense with what came before.

markers.name: Humour
markers.instructions: The current segment contains jokes, teasing or laughter.
